lastCompletedStory.title: Resolve orchestrator pid via ps ppid-walk (drop pgrep)

nextStoryContext: US-001 is the only story in this PRD. prd.json is now complete (all stories pass:true). The reviewer should run /cam-review. Key decisions: (1) PsSpawnFn takes no args (ps lists ALL processes; ppid filtering is in TS). (2) resolveChildViaPs is exported for direct unit testing, with helpers parsePsChildPids and emitAmbiguityEvent extracted for biome complexity. (3) >1 children returns highest pid (newest) and emits ambiguous-children event. (4) Integration test uses title-rewriting bun stand-in; pgrep-P blindness assertion is soft per EMPIRICAL CAVEAT.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed: -o pid=,ppid= format with empty = suppresses headers; -a lists all users processes; -x includes processes without controlling terminal. Output is space-padded two columns. Verified locally: ps -ax -o pid=,ppid= produces correct output. Implementation matches documented behavior.
